narrative.northStar: Hjemme ved fjorden (Home by the fjord)
narrative.overview: The site should look like the website of a small family business that knows the fjord better than it knows marketing. Tidy and easy to use, but never so polished it could be mistaken for a travel chain, a booking platform, or a generated company template. Three words: personal, simple, real. The design does not need to be perfect or symmetrical; no decoration is added just to make things look finished. The test for every element: would a small family business need this to explain the trip?
keyCharacteristics: Real photos from the Sognefjord, the boat, the guests, and the family
White and pale-fjord surfaces; dark band reserved for the personal quote
Still elements: color change on hover only; only the arrow may move
One clear heading per section; eyebrows and dividers are exceptions
Ordinary sentences and letter casing; written as Tor would explain it face to face

rules.name: The Still Water Rule
rules.body: White and fjord-light are the standard surfaces. The dark fjord band is used only when the content needs dark contrast, never as an automatic brand moment.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal marks what is clickable or worth noticing. If everything is teal, nothing is.

rules.name: The Plain Speech Rule
rules.body: Ordinary sentences and normal letter casing; no glossy marketing words when a plain word says the same.

rules.name: The One Heading Rule
rules.body: One clear heading per section. Do not add eyebrow and divider as fixed recipe decoration.

rules.name: The Standing Still Rule
rules.body: No lift, scaling, shadow growth, or unnecessary movement on cards and buttons. A simple color change on hover is enough; only the arrow may nudge. Focus is always visible.

dos: Remove an unnecessary element rather than restyle it; reuse existing Tailwind classes and tokens
Let real photos be the proof
Keep hover to a color change plus the arrow nudge
Keep focus always visible; never sacrifice contrast, readability, touch sizes, or the booking flow
Verify on mobile and desktop; uneven rows from real content are welcome
Write in first person where it fits
donts: No lift, scale, shadow growth, or movement on cards and buttons on hover
No stacking border + radius + shadow + badge + hover animation on one card
No eyebrow labels, decorative dividers, or icon circles as default recipe
No luxury or scale language, urgency, discounts, or artificial social proof
No ALL-CAPS content titles; uppercase is for short functional labels only
No new fonts, dark brand bands without informational content, or decorative illustrations on top of photos
Do not polish away personality or natural differences
